leash_walk.text: {npc} sits at the bar, and {name} kneels at her stool with the chain slack on the floor.
leash_walk.text_slave: {npc} sits at the bar. You kneel at her stool, chain slack on the floor, and the whole room politely does not look.

face_sit.text: {npc} drains her glass and, without looking down, tugs the chain. {name} slides under her skirts and stays there.
face_sit.text_slave: {npc} drains her glass and, without looking down, tugs the chain. You slide under her skirts and stay there, working, while she talks to the barkeeper.
